newsitem.title: USA: Fed's Phillips says M-2 measure a bit more helpful.
newsitem.headline: Fed's Phillips says M-2 measure a bit more helpful.

text.p: Federal Reserve Board Governor Susan Phillips said Thursday that the M-2 monetary aggregate had become "a bit more helpful" for Fed policymakers but still far off in its relationship to the economy.
Speaking to a business group, Phillips said "the relationship between M-2 and GDP generally has been a bit more stable ... but it's still pretty far off."

In answer to a question, she said that although M-2 has recently been near the upper end of the Fed's range, she did not see it as a problem. "I don't necessarily see it as a troublesome sign," she said.
